    points.sort()
    segments.sort()

    # Initialize colors array
    colors = [-1] * n

    # Try to assign colors to points
    for i in range(n):
        point = points[i]
        assigned = False

        for j in range(m):
            l, r = segments[j]
            if l <= point <= r:

                    # Assign color based on the segment

                        colors[i] = 0  # Only one point, must be red
                    else:

                elif colors[i] == 1:
                    # If already blue, check if it fits the segment
                    if r - l + 1 == 1:
                        return [-1]  # No valid assignment possible
                assigned = True
                break

        if not assigned:
            return [-1]  # Point not in any segment

    # Check if the assignment satisfies the condition
    for l, r in segments:
        red_count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if colors[i] == 0 and l <= points[i] <= r)
        blue_count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if colors[i] == 1 and l <= points[i] <= r)
        if abs(red_count - blue_count) > 1:
            return [-1]

    return colors
